summary_1line: Sahadeva’s southern conquest meets fierce resistance at Mahishmati where Agni protects King Nila due to a past marriage with Nila’s daughter.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sahadeva’s army of chariots, elephants, and armored soldiers appears engulfed in supernatural flames as the god Agni aids King Nila.
King Nila bows before the blazing god Agni who reveals himself after being discovered in Brahmana form with the princess.
The princess leans close to the sacred fire, her breath causing the flames to flare brightly in the palace shrine.
